rationale: Vehicle was rear-ended and totaled in a collision; auto claims take precedence regardless of any third-party fault or injury components.
severity_rationale: Vehicle is a total loss; claimant sustained injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist) that required medical attention beyond first aid, pushing this to high severity.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) rear-ended on Route 9 at red light; vehicle totaled with trunk crushed; claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver at fault; police report and other insurance info available. High severity due to total loss and injury. $750 deductible; $100K coverage limit.

case_facts.vehicle_damage: Car totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.fault: Other driver at fault; police report filed; other driver's insurance information on police report

rationale: A vehicle is the object of the loss (hood and windshield damage), making this an auto claim despite the tree being the proximate cause; wind is a standard covered peril.
severity_rationale: Damage to hood and windshield suggests moderate repair costs likely in the $5,000–$50,000 range, with no reported injuries; this falls in the medium severity band.
claim_summary: Wind-felled maple tree from policyholder's front yard struck parked car in driveway, damaging hood and windshield. Active auto coverage; $1,000 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: maple tree from policyholder's yard fell in wind and landed on parked car
